preview.tournamentOverview: Detroit Golf Club rewards ball-striking and distance control over pure putting. The course weights emphasize off-the-tee and approach play, making SG OTT (26.8%) and SG APP (21.3%) the primary drivers of success. The Rocket Classic sits as a mid-tier PGA Tour stop where strong SG Total performers can separate from the field.
preview.modelExplainer: Our model applies the highest weight to SG OTT at 26.8%, followed by SG Total at 22.8% and SG APP at 21.3%. SG ATG (10.6%) and SG PUTT (8.4%) carry less influence, while ancillary stats like Driving Accuracy (4.1%) and Bogey Avoidance (3.0%) provide minor adjustments. This weighting structure prioritizes players who gain strokes through accurate long game and approach play.
preview.pickApproach: We tier players by combining tournament-specific SG projections with baseline power rankings. Top-tier selections focus on high SG OTT and SG APP marks that align with course demands. Mid-tier bets target value where SG Total outpaces power rank, while fade candidates show inflated ranks relative to weak ball-striking metrics.

article.title: Rocket Classic 2026: Model Ranks Lead at Detroit Golf Club
article.dek: Tournament model identifies Cameron Young, Si Woo Kim, and Jake Knapp as top-ranked players for the 147-player field.
article.introduction: The Rocket Classic model at Detroit Golf Club weights SG OTT at 26.8% and SG APP at 21.3%, producing a top-20 list led by Cameron Young at rank 1 with 1.574 SG Total. Si Woo Kim sits at model rank 2 with 1.236 SG Total, while Jake Knapp ranks third at 2.002 SG Total. The field includes 147 players with no weather or tee-time data available.

sections.heading: Tournament Overview
sections.body: Detroit Golf Club hosts the Rocket Classic with course weights emphasizing SG OTT at 26.8% and SG APP at 21.3%. The 147-player field features model ranks based on strokes-gained data across five categories.

sections.heading: Course Fit
sections.body: SG OTT carries the highest weight at 26.8%, followed by SG APP at 21.3% and SG Total at 22.8%. Cameron Young leads with 0.699 SG OTT, while Akshay Bhatia ranks 10th despite -0.044 SG OTT.

sections.heading: Recent Form
sections.body: Jake Knapp leads the top-20 model with 2.002 SG Total, followed by Jacob Bridgeman at 1.933 SG Total. Cameron Young ranks first in the model with 1.574 SG Total and 0.699 SG OTT.

sections.heading: Post-Open Workload
sections.body: Si Woo Kim, Chris Gotterup, Russell Henley, Hideki Matsuyama, Cameron Young, Jacob Bridgeman, Xander Schauffele, Ryan Gerard, Patrick Cantlay, and Rickie Fowler each have FOUR_ROUNDS tracked. Nicolai Højgaard, Jake Knapp, and Akshay Bhatia have TWO_ROUNDS tracked.

sections.heading: FedExCup Motivation
sections.body: Cameron Young holds FedExCup rank #3, Chris Gotterup sits at #5, and Si Woo Kim ranks #7. Nicolai Højgaard is at #30, while Patrick Cantlay sits at #43.

sections.heading: Crossover Research Angles
sections.body: Si Woo Kim, Chris Gotterup, Cameron Young, Jacob Bridgeman, and Xander Schauffele combine skipped Scottish Open participation with top-10 model ranks. Ryan Gerard, Patrick Cantlay, and Rickie Fowler show tournament model ranks well ahead of power ranks.

sections.heading: Outright Targets
sections.body: Si Woo Kim ranks second in the model with 1.236 SG Total but carries -0.39 SG Putt risk. Chris Gotterup ranks sixth with 1.335 SG Total and 0.023 SG Putt. Nicolai Højgaard ranks eighth with 1.568 SG Total after missing the Open cut. Russell Henley ranks 11th with 1.186 SG Total and 0.313 SG APP. Hideki Matsuyama ranks 12th with 1.197 SG Total and -0.099 SG OTT.

sections.heading: Top-10 Targets
sections.body: Cameron Young leads the model at rank 1 with 1.574 SG Total. Jake Knapp ranks third with 2.002 SG Total and 0.264 SG OTT. Jacob Bridgeman ranks fourth with 1.933 SG Total and -0.152 SG ATG. Xander Schauffele ranks fifth with 1.443 SG Total and 0.423 SG OTT. Akshay Bhatia ranks 10th with 1.646 SG Total and -0.044 SG OTT.

sections.heading: Top-20 Targets
sections.body: Nicolai Højgaard ranks eighth with 0.256 SG OTT. Russell Henley ranks 11th with 0.313 SG APP. Hideki Matsuyama ranks 12th with -0.099 SG OTT. Ryan Gerard ranks 13th with -0.276 SG ATG. Patrick Cantlay ranks 14th with 0.146 SG APP. Rickie Fowler ranks 18th with 0.111 SG APP.

sections.heading: Data Limitations
sections.body: Weather and tee-time data are unavailable. Workload coverage includes only recorded rounds from The Open Championship and Genesis Scottish Open. Opposite-field, DP World Tour, LIV, and other events may be missing.

sections.heading: Final Betting Card
sections.body: Strong model-supported bets: Cameron Young (rank 1), Jake Knapp (rank 3), Jacob Bridgeman (rank 4). Secondary targets: Si Woo Kim (rank 2), Chris Gotterup (rank 6), Nicolai Højgaard (rank 8). Speculative plays: Ryan Gerard (rank 13), Patrick Cantlay (rank 14), Rickie Fowler (rank 18).

article.conclusion: Strong model-supported bets: Cameron Young, Jake Knapp, Jacob Bridgeman. Secondary targets: Si Woo Kim, Chris Gotterup, Nicolai Højgaard. Speculative plays: Ryan Gerard, Patrick Cantlay, Rickie Fowler.
